policies.title: Image runs as root
policies.description: Checks that the final stage sets a non-root USER.
policies.rationale: Root inside the container makes any application bug more costly.
policies.absence_note: No USER in the final stage means the process runs as root: treated as a failure.
policies.remediation: Create a dedicated user and add USER <uid>.
policies.negative:
FROM alpine:3.20
RUN adduser -D app
USER app

policies.title: Base image uses latest or no tag
policies.description: Checks that FROM images carry an explicit non-latest tag (build-argument images are skipped).
policies.remediation: Pin a version tag, ideally a digest.

policies.title: Base image is not pinned by digest
policies.description: Checks that FROM references include a digest.
policies.rationale: Digests are immutable; tags can be repointed (the Docker guide also notes the trade-off of missing automatic updates).
policies.remediation: Pin by digest and use an update bot to refresh it.

policies.title: Build pipes a download straight into a shell
policies.description: Checks that no RUN downloads and executes in one step.
policies.rationale: The script is not verified and can change between builds.
policies.remediation: Download, verify a checksum or signature, then run.
policies.positive:
FROM alpine:3.20
RUN curl -fsSL https://x.example/i.sh | sh
policies.negative:
FROM alpine:3.20
RUN curl -fsSLO https://x.example/i.tgz && sha256sum -c i.sha

policies.title: A secret is baked into the image with ENV
policies.description: Checks that ENV variables with secret-like names are empty or variable references.
policies.rationale: ENV values persist in image layers and can be read by anyone with the image.
policies.remediation: Use build secrets (RUN --mount=type=secret) or runtime injection.

policies.title: A secret default is set in an ARG
policies.description: Checks that ARG variables with secret-like names have no literal default.
policies.rationale: Build arguments are visible in image history.
policies.absence_note: No secret-like ARG names with defaults.
policies.remediation: Pass secrets with build secrets, not ARG.

policies.title: ADD fetches a remote URL
policies.description: Checks that ADD is not used to download.
policies.rationale: ADD from a URL has no integrity check unless --checksum is used.
policies.remediation: Use COPY for local files; download with a checksum for remote ones.

policies.title: RUN uses sudo
policies.description: Checks that RUN does not use sudo.
policies.rationale: Build steps already run as root; sudo hints at a mixed-privilege image.
policies.positive:
FROM alpine:3.20
RUN sudo apk add curl
policies.negative:
FROM alpine:3.20
RUN apk add curl

policies.title: Build disables TLS verification
policies.description: Checks that RUN does not turn off certificate checks.
policies.rationale: Disabled verification allows tampering of build inputs.

policies.title: Image exposes port 22
policies.description: Checks that EXPOSE does not list port 22.
policies.rationale: An SSH daemon in a container is rarely needed and widens the attack surface.
policies.remediation: Use the container runtime's exec facilities.

policies.title: Image has no health check
policies.description: Checks that a HEALTHCHECK is defined.
policies.rationale: Without it the engine cannot tell a hung service from a healthy one.
policies.absence_note: No HEALTHCHECK in the final stage: treated as a failure (orchestrators may probe instead, which is not visible here).
policies.remediation: Add a HEALTHCHECK suited to the service.
policies.negative:
FROM alpine:3.20
HEALTHCHECK CMD wget -q -O- http://localhost:8080/health

policies.title: apt-get install pulls recommended packages
policies.description: Checks that apt installs use --no-install-recommends (each install line is checked).
policies.rationale: Extra packages enlarge the attack surface.
policies.positive:
FROM debian:12
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl
policies.negative:
FROM debian:12
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl

policies.title: Private keys or env files are copied into the image
policies.description: Checks that COPY/ADD do not name key material or .env files.
policies.rationale: Anything copied into a layer can be extracted from the image.
policies.remediation: Use build secrets or runtime mounts.

policies.title: Build sets a user password on the command line
policies.description: Checks that RUN does not set account passwords.
policies.rationale: Hard-coded passwords persist in the image history.
